The use of incorrect or defective material would create a high probability of failure resulting in serious personnel injury, loss of life, loss of vitalshipboard systems, or loss of the ship itself.  Therefore, the material has been designated as SPECIAL EMPHASIS material (Level I, Scope of Certification, or Quality Assured) and special control procedures are invoked to ensure receipt of correct material.2.
